transcript:
AGENT: Hi, this is an automated call regarding your account. This is an attempt to collect a debt; any information obtained will be used for that purpose. Do you have a moment to discuss your account?
RECIPIENT: Yes, go ahead.
AGENT: Thanks. Our records show a payment of $180 was due on the 3rd. Would you like to set up a payment plan today?
RECIPIENT: Sure, that works.
AGENT: Great, I'll note that and a specialist will follow up with the plan details.
summary: Recipient acknowledged the debt and agreed to a follow-up call to arrange a payment plan. No opt-out.
